description: This file defines a function to build database query conditions for booking time statuses based on various filters such as team, event, user, and organization context. It interacts with Prisma ORM models to generate complex where conditions.

methods.name: buildBaseWhereCondition
methods.description: Asynchronously constructs a Prisma where condition object for booking time statuses based on input filters and context, including organization-wide and team-specific filters.
